name: evidence-media-restoration
description: Configurable evidence-preserving photo/video restoration with exact frame metadata, robust fusion, model audits, and provenance.

interface.longDescription: A working configurable pipeline for images and video: source/codec inventory, PyAV PTS and frame-type capture when available, projective rectification, ECC registration, robust multi-frame fusion, donor/support/dispersion products, non-semantic deconvolution sweeps, pseudo-holdout and residual diagnostics, hashes, reports, and provenance. Neural restorers remain optional non-evidentiary suggestions.
defaultPrompt: Restore this media with provenance and uncertainty.
Compare frames without inventing unreadable details.
